caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular, brown-colored object positioned centrally on a beige background. The rectangle, measuring 12 1/4 inches by 8 1/2 inches as marked by dimensional annotations along the right and bottom sides, contains an array of regularly spaced small white dots forming symmetrical, decorative patterns. The dot formations include straight lines that cross both vertically and horizontally at the rectangle's center, as well as circular and curved motifs evenly distributed throughout the interior, dividing the space into four quadrants. There are no other objects within the depiction except for the signature "Geoffrey Holt" written in the lower right corner near a smear of orange-brown color. The composition is simple with the main object occupying the center of the drawing and surrounded by ample empty space.
title: Pierced Metal Screen from Confessional
